name: favicon-fetch
description: Universal favicon fetcher with smart fallback chain. One call, best icon, works everywhere — Node.js, Deno, Bun, Cloudflare Workers.

scripts.record-demo: npx tsx scripts/record-demo.ts && ffmpeg -y -i tmp-video/*.webm -ss 1 -vf "fps=10,scale=800:-1:flags=lanczos,split[s0][s1];[s0]palettegen=max_colors=256:stats_mode=full[p];[s1][p]paletteuse=dither=bayer:bayer_scale=5:diff_mode=rectangle" -loop 0 assets/demo-raw.gif && gifsicle -O3 assets/demo-raw.gif -o assets/demo.gif && rm assets/demo-raw.gif && rm -rf tmp-video

author: Franz Benthin
